simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָפַק (H662) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אָפַק (ʼâphaq) means to contain , i.e. (reflex.) abstain First listed occurrence: 1Sam 13 12.

definitions.full: H662. aphaq [ אָפַק ] verb hold, be strong (so Thes who compare Arabic excel = multum valuit ; MV compare also ) — only Hithpa`el Perfect 3plural הִתְאַמָּ֑קוּ Isa 63:15 ; Imperfect וַיִּתְאַפַק Gen 43:21 ; Est 5:10 ; 2 masculine singular תִּתְאַמַּק Isa 64:11 ; אֶתְאַמָּ֑ק 42:14 ; וָאֶתְאַמַּק 1Sam 13:12 — 1 force, compel oneself 1Sam 13:12 . 2 restrain oneself, refrain Gen 43:31 ; 45:1 ; Isa 42:14 ; Est 5:10 ; of ׳י Isa 64:11 ; of Yahweh's compassion 63:15 , הִתְּאַמָּ֑קוּ אֵלַי וְרַחֲמֶיךָ מֵעֶיךָ (almost passive).
